description: Category 1 (numerical) questions with integer answers, authored from the challenge sample questions and reference images in questions/chinese_room/questions.pdf. Objects are restricted to salient, visually verifiable furniture and decor so a human can confirm every answer from the scene. Each question carries a machine-readable spec that scripts/eval/verify_benchmark2.py re-evaluates against the iref_vla object bounding boxes.
notes: Q01 is the official Category 1 sample question from questions/chinese_room/questions.pdf; its answer (6) is the answer printed in the PDF.
difficulty: easy = single salient object class; medium = one relation or one color attribute; hard = two chained relations.

Only large, unambiguous objects are counted. Focus lights, light switches, figurines and structural classes (wall/floor/ceiling) are excluded because they are too small or too abstract to ground reliably.
The room has a dining table with four armchairs, a wooden daybed behind a carved partition, two armchairs in front of the south windows, and a TV cabinet on the west wall.
'Potted plant' is avoided as a count target because the scene also labels a potted bamboo and a potted branch, which a human would count inconsistently.
object_ids lists supporting iref_vla scene-graph ids for auditing; SAM3 should use target_objects.

questions.question: Count the number of chairs with pillows on them.
questions.evidence: All six chairs carry a red pillow: four around the dining table (29, 61, 81, 86) and two in front of the windows (60, 84).

questions.question: How many chairs are in the room?
questions.evidence: Six wooden armchairs: 29, 61, 81, 86 around the dining table and 60, 84 by the windows.

questions.question: How many red lanterns are hanging from the ceiling?
questions.evidence: Two red paper lanterns hang from the ceiling (31, 43).

questions.question: How many windows are in the room?
questions.evidence: Two large windows span the south wall (67, 90).

questions.question: How many stools are in the room?
How many pillows are on the wooden daybed?
questions.evidence: The wooden daybed (48) carries four pillows: red 66, 83 and yellow 85, 87.

questions.question: How many yellow pillows are on the wooden daybed?
questions.evidence: Two of the daybed's four pillows are yellow (85, 87); the other two are red.

questions.question: How many chairs are around the table with the bowls on it?
questions.evidence: The dining table (88) holds bowls 71 and 91 and is surrounded by chairs 29, 61, 81, 86.

questions.question: How many chairs are in front of the windows?
questions.evidence: Chairs 60 and 84 stand in front of window 90 on the south wall; the four dining chairs are more than 3 m away from either window.

questions.question: How many books are on the cabinet below the TV?
questions.evidence: Books 57 and 58 are stacked on cabinet 89, which sits below the wall-mounted TV 19; the third book (45) is on the tea table.
